summary: Frontend-only verification of the two reported bug fixes plus regression sweep. (1) /processi pull quote now contains BOTH sentences exactly, styled identically to the assetti pull quote (Source Serif 4, italic, rgb(30,58,107), 32px, my-24 = 96px top/bottom margins) and the second sentence appears exactly once on the page (only inside the pull quote, no duplicate Body paragraph). (2) /percorso timeline renders 4 filled navy circular nodes (12x12px, border-radius 9999px, background rgb(30,58,107), absolute, visible) sitting on the 1px navy/25 vertical line at the top of each of the 4 stages, at desktop 1920 and mobile 390. Regression: assetti pull quote unchanged, Source Serif 4 on all H1s across 10 routes, Home 'Le tre aree' true 3-column same-row layout with vertical dividers, all 4 criterio pages render numbered watermarks + side-index TOC (8-9 toc items), all 6 nav routes and all 5 inline deep-links navigate correctly, per-page titles and footer present on every route, no horizontal overflow at 1920/1024/390. No console errors observed. All checks passed; no issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Node horizontal centering is off by ~1px (node center x=601 vs line x=600 at desktop) due to left: calc(-2rem - 6px) against a 1px border; cosmetically invisible, optional to fine-tune with -0.5px.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration-7 bug fixes verified via Playwright computed-style assertions. Real criterio routes are /quando-il-problema-arriva, /metriche-e-statuto, /ai-senza-governance, /prima-che-manchi-la-liquidita (earlier guessed slugs like /patti-parasociali correctly render the NotFound page). Mobile hamburger menu (data-testid mobile-menu-toggle) was not exercised in this iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous defects were content/markup: the second sentence lived in a separate <Body> instead of inside <PullQuote>, and timeline nodes were 10px without a ring. Current code has both sentences in PullQuote and h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-navy ring-4 ring-white nodes; verified rendered output matches.
